operative_clauses.original_operative_text: it is hereby ordered that as of the effective date of this Order:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-101. The Secretary of the Treasury shall promulgate regulations:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-101 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) prohibiting any person subject to U.S. jurisdiction from prosecuting in any court within the United States or elsewhere any claim against the Government of Iran arising out of events occurring before the date of this Order relating to (1) the seizure of the hostages on November 4, 1979, (2) their subsequent detention, (3) injury to United States property or property of United States nationals within the United States Embassy compound in Tehran after November 3, 1979, or (4) injury to United States nationals or their property as a result of popular movements in the course of the Islamic Revolution in Iran which were not an act of the Government of Iran; (b) prohibiting any person not a U.S. national from prosecuting any such claim in any court within the United States; (c) ordering the termination of any previously instituted judicial proceedings based upon such claims; and (d) prohibiting the enforcement of any judicial order issued in the course of such proceedings.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-101(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-102. The Attorney General of the United States is authorized and directed, immediately upon the issuance of regulations in accordance with Section 1-101, to take all appropriate measures to notify all appropriate courts of the existence of this Order and implementing regulations and the resulting termination of litigation.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-102

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-103. The Secretary of the Treasury is delegated and authorized to exercise all functions vested in the President by the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.) to carry out the purpose of this Order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-103

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-104. This Order shall be effective immediately.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-104
